techniques.name: 按音乐标记插入定格帧
techniques.intent: 把运动暂停为照片，再从同一源位置恢复播放。

operations.frame: nearest declared frame grid at s_f

cue.selection: requires actual audition if based on voice onset

timing.rule: For local t<k sample s_in+t; k<=t<k+H sample s_f; t>=k+H sample s_in+t-H. Output duration increases byH when hold is inserted.

pitfalls: Insert-hold and replace-with-hold have different duration and audio alignment.
Still extraction must use the intended original source frame without an avoidable lossy screenshot.
Later video events shift by the hold duration; unrelated audio should follow an explicit policy.
validation: All decoded hold frames are identical before added effects.
Pre-hold and resume frames map to the intended adjacent source moment without a jump.
Output duration equals source span plus inserted hold; music cue mapping remains explicit.

techniques.name: 闪白与拍照声按可见事件对齐
techniques.intent: 用短白色闪光和同步音效强调照片瞬间。

timing.rule: audio_start=flash_onset-(source_onset-source_in)/speed; flash onset must be measured from the actual rendered effect, not assumed from transition center.

pitfalls: The exact proprietary flash envelope and overlap semantics are unknown.
A shutter asset requires provenance and permission even when the placement math is exact.
Audio onset inside a sound file can be delayed relative to the file start.
validation: Inspect flash first/peak/last frames and confirm recovery from white.
Audition flash and shutter together; verify no excessive level or truncation.
Check cue against actual flash onset within a chosen tolerance.

techniques.name: 分时段叠加清晰变化与录像机边框
techniques.intent: 让静止拍照与恢复运动各有视觉提示。

timing.rule: Overlay starts at resumed-motion segment boundary; intervals depend on freeze insertion duration.

pitfalls: The named变清晰 effect does not establish true optical refocusing or recover lost detail.
A hand-drawn camera HUD would be an approximation, not the exact proprietary asset.
Overlapping focus effects can compound; exact preset ordering is not established.
validation: Camera HUD appears only in the intended resumed segment and remains inside safe margins.
Inspect interval boundaries for unintended jumps.
Compare focus treatment with the source to avoid over-sharpening or blur artifacts.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; music wording and exact effect preset curves remain unknown.
Static screenshots verify timeline structure and UI values, not the full rendered motion or audible synchronization.
